column1: # The Netherlands (nl.cautious): no authority. At Amsterdam, on the 2026 days both are held (25 September to
# 25 October), in the local archive (europe/split-7g/): the Moroccan calendar as Al-Ihsane's Mawaqit page
# carries it (member nl.moroccan) and Diyanet's Amsterdam table (member tr.diyanet.europe, subtask 7b's
# method; its Fajr is also its imsak). No table of the third member, MWL 18°/17°, is held. Every row is
# held out (a cautious entry has no margins of its own).
# Not a row: the weekly monitor's Amsterdam capture of 28 Sep 2026 (29 Sep – 29 Oct 2026 and 2027). After 25
# October only Diyanet's table would be held here, and the cautious Fajr, Isha and end of eating follow the other
# members (the Moroccan calendar's Fajr, MWL's Isha), so against Diyanet's alone they read as the members' spread:
# Fajr over its 16 min on 262 days (up to 37; 26–29 October among them), Isha over its 6 on 303 (up to 131), the
# end of eating over its 2 on 127 (up to 123 min early, in 2027). It waits for the Moroccan calendar's table for
